note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 12 Package 2 affiliation evidence corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation, operations, evidence, acceptance, or release.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation database-behaviour evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.required_evidence_classes: Automated test evidence; manual test evidence.
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Physical database state, version, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Schema exists is not database invariant proven.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation data-integrity evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: No error observed is not integrity proven.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation financial-reconciliation evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Reconciliation record across the three parties.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Provider acknowledgement is not accounting confirmation is not reconciliation.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation migration evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Stage, batch, source authority, and reconciliation record.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Migration executed is not migration accepted is not source retired.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation activation and standing evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Activation and standing records bound to the system of record.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Approval is not activation authorization is not activation execution is not active standing.
